test_grammar_generation: test the constrained grammar generation for multi-agent tool calls and response formats using EBNF parsing
build_tool_grammar: build an EBNF grammar string from a world graph to constrain LLM tool call generation
build_response_grammar: build an EBNF grammar for full agent responses including thought, action, and assignment fields
parse_ebnf_grammar: parse an EBNF grammar string into a structured grammar encoding with a symbol table for validation
validate_tool_call_with_recognizer: validate that a tool call string conforms to the generated grammar using a StringRecognizer
